mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_member_stats_daily ( project_id, author_key, author_name, stat_date, commit_count, tasks_reviewed, additions_sum, deletions_sum, issues_new, issues_open, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{authorKey}, #{authorName}, #{statDate}, #{commitCount}, #{tasksReviewed}, #{additionsSum}, #{deletionsSum}, #{issuesNew}, #{issuesOpen}, SYSDATE(), SYSDATE() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE author_name = VALUES(author_name), commit_count = VALUES(commit_count), tasks_reviewed = VALUES(tasks_reviewed), additions_sum = VALUES(additions_sum), deletions_sum = VALUES(deletions_sum), issues_new = VALUES(issues_new), issues_open = VALUES(issues_open), update_time = SYSDATE()
